paite: Huchi in Teman mi Eliphaz in hichi in achi:
heading: Houlim Thumveina / (Job 22.1-27.23) / Eliphaz Thugen Nanungpen
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

paite: "Pathian a ding in mihing aphatuam thei diam? Kuapeuh apil amah mah a ding in aphatuam ngei a.
english: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

paite: Na diktat, Bangkim hihthei a ding a kipahna ahi a hia? Ahihkeileh na lampite na hoihkimsak, amah a dia punna hia?
english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him, that you make your ways perfect?

paite: Nang ahon salha, vaihawmna a nang toh alut, amah na kihtak ziak hia?
english: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

paite: Na gitlouhna alian kei maw? Na thulimlouhna ah leng tawpna a-om sam kei hi.
english: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

paite: "Bangmah lou ding in na unau thuchiamte na la a, vuaktangte puansilh na suahsak hi.
english: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

paite: Bahte a ding in dawn ding tui na pe kei a, gilkial a ding in tanghou na it hi.
english: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

paite: Himahleh mihat in gam anei a; asung ah ami deihthoh ateng hi.
english: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

paite: Khutvuak in meithaite na sawlmang a, pabeite khutte hihtan in a-om hi.
english: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

paite: Huaiziak in na kim ah thangte a-om ua, lauguihna in nang ahon hihbuai hi.
english: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

paite: Ahihkeileh khomial, na muh theih louh, leh tui tampi in nang ahon khuh hi.
english: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

paite: "Van sang ah Pathian a-om kei a hia? Aksite sandan en in, sang hi na tel uh e;
english: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

paite: Nang, 'Pathian in bang athei a? Khomial bikbek ah vai ahawm thei dia hia?
english: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

paite: Ama'n hon muhlouhna ding a, meipi sah in liah a, van dum khen a vak ahi,' na chi hi.
english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

paite: Migiloute totsa lampi lui na kem ding hia?
english: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

paite: Ahun ma ua lakmang a-om a, akingakna ua tui luang bang a butkhiak a omte.
english: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

paite: Pathian kiang a, 'Hon paimangsan in; huan ei a ding in Bangkim hihthei in bang ahihthei a?' chite.
english: who said to God, ‘Depart from us;’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

paite: Himahleh a-innte uh thil hoih in adimsak ua, himahleh migiloute thugen kei a kipan agamla hi.
english: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

paite: Midiktatte'n amu ua, akipak uh; mihoihte'n amau anuihsan ua,
english: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

paite: Chihtaktak in ei dou ding a thoute satkhiak in a-om ua, amaute lak a khosuaksunte mei in ahulta," chi in.
english: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

paite: "Tu in amah kimeltheihpih inla, muangtak in om in. Huai ah hoih na kiang ah ahong pai ding hi.
english: “Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. Thereby good shall come to you.

paite: Akam a kipan in dan sang in, ka hon ngen hi, na lungtang ah athute kholkhawm in.
english: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

paite: Bangkim hihthei kiang a na kik nawnleh, lamkip na hi ding; na puaninte a kipan gamlapi ah diktatlouhna na koihmang ding ahi.
english: If you return to the Almighty, you shall be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

paite: Huan na gou leivui ah koih inla, luite suangte lak ah Ophir dangka-eng;
english: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

paite: Bangkim hihthei na gou ahi dia, dangka manpha nang a ding in
english: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

paite: Bangkim hihthei ah kipak in, Pathian kiang ah daktou ding na hih ziak in.
english: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and shall lift up your face to God.

paite: Amah kiang ah na thum ding a, ama'n hon na za ding a, na thuchiam na tangtun ding hi.
english: You shall make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You shall pay your vows.

paite: Thil khat tung ah thupukna bawl in thu na pe dia, nang a ding in hihkip in a-om ding; huchi in na lampite ah khovak atang ding hi.
english: You shall also decree a thing, and it shall be established to you. Light shall shine on your ways.

paite: Ahon sawnpuk chiang un, 'Thohtouhna a-om,' na chi ding. Hihniam a omte ama'n ahondam ding hi.
english: When they cast down, you shall say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

paite: Ama'n ahoih lou nangawn asuaktasak ding a; ahi, na khutte sianna ziak in amah suahtaksak in a-om ding."
english: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he shall be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
